title: Query length bounded by running time
statement: Let $M$ be an oracle Turing machine with $k$ ordinary work tapes, let $O$ be an oracle language, let $x$ be an input word, and let $t$ be a natural number. The query string in the configuration reached after $t$ steps from the initial configuration on $x$ has length at most $t$.
hypotheses_covered: An oracle Turing machine with $k$ ordinary work tapes
replaced:
Let $M$ be an oracle machine with $k$ ordinary work tapes, $O$ an oracle
language, $x$ an input word, and $t \in \mathbb{N}$.  In the configuration
reached by running $M$ with oracle $O$ for $t$ steps from its initial
configuration on $x$, the query string --- the contents of the query tape from
cell $0$ up to the first blank cell --- has length at most $t$.
